title: Immunization Services Record Standard — Outside-Record Scheduling Allowance
content:
Records and Compliance, Immunization Services record standard. The outside-record allowance forms part of Kestrel's scheduling allowance for a phone appointment for the next dose of a vaccination series.

## 1. Standard

The outside-record allowance is **1 day** where the series history carries a dose entry not reported by Kestrel and an invalidation entry, **3 days** where it carries a dose entry not reported by Kestrel and no invalidation entry, and nothing where every dose entry was reported by Kestrel.

## 2. Record terms

- **Dose entry** — a dose-given entry on the series history, whether Kestrel gave the dose or it was recorded from another provider.
- **Reported by Kestrel** — Kestrel's report of a dose to the state immunization registry, shown on the series history as a registry report entry.
- **A dose entry not reported by Kestrel** is on the history when the dose entries on it outnumber Kestrel's registry report entries on it. Where the registry report entries are as many as the dose entries, every dose entry counts as reported by Kestrel.
- **Invalidation entry** — an entry recording that a dose on the history does not count, whatever its reason.

## 3. Determination matrix

| Dose entries outnumber registry reports | Invalidation entry on the history | Outside-record allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 1 day |
| yes | no | 3 days |
| no | yes | nothing |
| no | no | nothing |

## 4. Hypothetical illustrations

- Three dose entries, two registry reports, one invalidation entry: three outnumber two and an invalidation entry is present — 1 day.
- Two dose entries, one registry report, no invalidation entry — 3 days.
- Two dose entries, two registry reports, one invalidation entry: the dose entries do not outnumber the reports — nothing.
